knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Access is removed when the stay ends so it cannot be used by someone else.
People are moved to safety and the emergency service is called. The host does not enter the affected area.
The host records and escalates. Liability and settlement decisions belong to the owner.

practicalCriteria: Assessor gives an emergency scenario and checks that the candidate names the first action and the call to make
Assessor checks that the candidate sets and removes a guest code and records each change
Assessor reviews an incident record for date, time, what was seen and who was told
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Access register entry with start and end times
stopWorkCriteria: The candidate enters an area with a gas smell or smoke to check
The candidate agrees a refund or settlement without the owner
The candidate leaves a guest access code active after checkout
